# UNCUT ELECTRO-MECHANICAL ENGINEERING

> Uncut Electro-Mechanical Engineering provides expert precision engineering, electro-mechanical repairs, machining, fitting, turning, and industrial machinery maintenance based in Krugersdorp & Chamdor, Gauteng.

## Key Pages & Information

* [Homepage](https://uncutelecmech.co.za/): Overview of precision engineering, workshop capabilities, and electro-mechanical repair services.
* [About Us](https://uncutelecmech.co.za/about): Company background, team expertise, workshop facilities, and commitment to quality engineering standards.
* [Services](https://uncutelecmech.co.za/services): Detailed breakdown of industrial machinery maintenance, electrical fitting, CNC machining, turning, and dynamic balancing.
* [Industries](https://uncutelecmech.co.za/industries): Industrial sectors served including mining, manufacturing, food & beverage, processing, and heavy engineering.
* [FAQ](https://uncutelecmech.co.za/faq): Answers to common questions regarding repair turnaround times, quote requests, warranties, and emergency support.
* [Contact & RFQ](https://uncutelecmech.co.za/contact): Online RFQ submission form, direct email, phone contacts, and physical workshop location in Krugersdorp/Chamdor.
